name: What kind of paint is best for interior walls?

mainEntity.name: What kind of paint is best for interior walls?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best kind of paint for interior walls depends on the room and your lifestyle. For high-traffic areas like hallways and kitchens, durable, washable paints like satin or semi-gloss are often recommended. For living rooms and bedrooms, matte or eggshell finishes offer a softer look. We use high-quality, low-VOC paints for better air quality and durability. Frasheski Construction can help you select the ideal paint type and finish for each area of your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: The best interior paint depends on the room and lifestyle; durable paints for high-traffic areas, softer finishes for living spaces. We help select the ideal type.
